title: B2+ · L44 — AI & ML vocabulary
description: Vocabulario de AI/ML: model, prompt, hallucination, alignment, fine-tuning, RAG.

questions.prompt: Un colega no tech te pregunta que significan las siglas que aparecen en cada articulo sobre AI.
questions.question: In AI, an 'LLM' is:
questions.explanation: LLM = Large Language Model. GPT (OpenAI), Claude (Anthropic), Gemini (Google), Llama (Meta) son LLMs. Entrenados con enormes corpora de texto (trillones de tokens). Base de la revolucion actual de AI post-2022. Pronunciacion: siempre letra por letra /ɛlɛlˈɛm/, nunca como palabra. Registro: tecnico universal. Familia: SLM (Small Language Model), VLM (Vision Language Model), MLM (Masked Language Model). Error hispano: pronunciar como palabra o traducir siglas — se mantienen en ingles en toda literatura anglo y hispana tech.
examples: LLMs like Claude 4.7 handle nuanced reasoning at near-human levels. → capacidad actual
Each new LLM generation raises the bar on what's possible. → progreso continuo

questions.prompt: Un usuario reporta que el chatbot les cito un articulo cientifico que no existe.
questions.question: 'Hallucination' in AI means:
options: A visual rendering bug in the interface.
The model generating plausible but false information confidently.
Slow response time from the server.
questions.explanation: Hallucination = LLM genera informacion falsa con alta confianza aparente. Problema CENTRAL de safety en LLMs — el modelo no distingue entre 'lo que sabe' y 'lo que suena plausible'. Diferente de bug: es FEATURE inherente de arquitectura generativa (predice el siguiente token, no consulta hechos). Mitigar es active research (RAG, groundedness, chain-of-verification). Registro: AI safety, ML engineering. Error usuario: confiar en outputs sin verificar — hallucinations pueden ser muy convincentes.
examples: The model hallucinated a citation that doesn't exist — we caught it during review. → riesgo tipico
Hallucination rates dropped significantly in newer frontier models. → progreso medible

questions.statement: 'Prompt engineering' is the practice of crafting inputs to get better outputs from LLMs.
questions.explanation: VERDADERO. Prompt engineering = arte/ciencia de escribir prompts optimizados. Tecnicas clave: 'zero-shot' (sin ejemplos), 'few-shot' (con ejemplos), 'chain-of-thought' (pensar paso a paso), 'role prompting' (asignar rol al modelo), 'delimiter usage'. Skill de alta demanda actual — Anthropic, OpenAI, Google pagan roles de prompt engineer >$300K USD. Registro: AI/tech professional. Error hispano: subestimar como skill 'no tecnica' — buenos prompts pueden duplicar performance del modelo, es habilidad rigurosamente empirica.
examples: Good prompt engineering can double model performance without any fine-tuning. → dato empirico
Chain-of-thought prompting improves complex reasoning tasks dramatically. → tecnica clave

questions.prompt: Tu equipo esta considerando como adaptar Claude a los tickets de soporte especificos de tu empresa.
questions.question: 'Fine-tuning' means:
options: Further training a pre-trained model on domain-specific data.
Making the training slower and more careful.
questions.explanation: Fine-tuning = adaptar modelo pre-entrenado a task/domain especifico con dataset adicional. Alternativa a training from scratch (que costaria millones de dolares). Common technique en enterprise AI. Registro: ML engineering. Alternativas modernas: LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation, fine-tuning eficiente), RAG (retrieval-augmented generation, sin fine-tuning), few-shot prompting (a veces suficiente). Error hispano: pronunciar 'fine' como 'fin' — se pronuncia /faɪn/. Tradeoff clave: fine-tuning es potente pero costoso vs prompting/RAG.
examples: We fine-tuned the model on our support tickets — accuracy jumped 30%. → caso real
Fine-tuning outperforms prompting for narrow, well-defined tasks. → tradeoff tecnico

questions.text: The model was trained on a diverse dataset but still exhibits bias in certain edge cases.
questions.explanation: Discurso ML honesto y maduro. Fenomeno de connected speech: 'trained on a' con enlazado /treɪndɒnə/; 'exhibits bias' con /tsb/ cluster, la /s/ tiende a debilitarse; 'edge cases' se pronuncia como unidad rítmica /ˈedʒkeɪsɪz/. Vocabulario preciso: 'trained on diverse dataset' (metodologia), 'exhibits bias' (fenomeno), 'edge cases' (limitacion). Marca de ingeniero ML maduro que reconoce limitaciones. Registro: technical writing, ML documentation, safety reports. Error hispano: 'bias' se pronuncia /ˈbaɪəs/, no /bias/ literal.
examples: Model bias remains an active area of research and remediation. → estado de campo
Even diverse datasets can embed subtle biases that emerge in production. → advertencia realista

questions.prompt: Lees un articulo de Anthropic sobre por que trabajan en asegurar que la AI actue como esperamos.
questions.question: 'Alignment' in AI refers to:
options: Organizing files and folders in the system.
Ensuring AI systems act in accordance with human values.
questions.explanation: AI alignment = hacer que AI actue segun valores e intenciones humanas, especialmente a medida que aumenta capacidad. Central en AI safety research. Tecnicas: RLHF (reinforcement learning from human feedback), Constitutional AI (Anthropic), red teaming, interpretability research. Registro: AI safety, tech policy. Es arguably 'the hardest problem in AI'. Error hispano: confundir con 'alineamiento' de rueda de coche — el termino AI es especifico y no traducible directamente. La palabra 'alignment' se usa incluso en articulos en espanol.
examples: Alignment is arguably the hardest open problem in AI safety today. → nivel de dificultad
RLHF is one of the main current approaches to alignment. → tecnica estandar

questions.prompt: Empareja cada termino de AI/ML con su descripcion:

pairs.right: Unidad de texto para el modelo

questions.explanation: Vocabulario esencial de AI/ML actual (2024+). 'Token' es sub-palabra (tipicamente 3-4 caracteres en ingles); modelos cobran por tokens de input y output. 'Inference' es cuando modelo produce output para nuevos inputs (vs 'training' cuando aprende de datos). Distincion critica en costos: training es caro y one-time; inference es marginal pero escala con uso. Registro: technical universal, aparece en toda documentacion AI. Error hispano: no distinguir training vs inference confunde discusiones de coste.
examples: Each API call costs based on input and output tokens processed. → economia de LLMs
Inference latency matters enormously for real-time consumer apps. → constraint de UX

questions.target: We use retrieval-augmented generation to ground the model's answers in our documentation and reduce hallucinations.
questions.explanation: Discurso AI engineer avanzado con vocabulario preciso 2024+. 'Retrieval-augmented generation' (RAG — pronunciado como palabra /ræɡ/, no letras) + 'ground answers' (basar respuestas en fuentes verificables) + 'reduce hallucinations'. RAG es la arquitectura mas comun para enterprise AI en 2024-2026. Ritmo natural: pausa breve tras 'retrieval-augmented generation', tempo tecnico calmado, enfasis en 'ground' y 'reduce'. Contracciones: 'model's' obligatoria. Registro: technical presentation, AI engineering.
examples: RAG improves factual accuracy dramatically over pure prompting. → mejora medible
We use embeddings + vector search for retrieval, then pass context to the LLM. → arquitectura tipica

questions.prompt: Lees un paper sobre las capacidades sorpresivas que aparecen en LLMs muy grandes.
questions.question: 'Emergent behavior' in large models refers to:
options: Capabilities that appear unexpectedly as scale increases.
questions.explanation: Emergent behavior = capacidades NO explicitamente entrenadas que aparecen a cierta escala (parametros, datos, compute). Ejemplos: few-shot learning, chain-of-thought reasoning, in-context learning. Fenomeno key en modern AI y motivo por el que empresas invierten en modelos mas grandes. Registro: AI research, technical writing. Debate abierto: emergence es real o artefacto de metricas? Papers recientes cuestionan (Schaeffer et al 2023). Error hispano: interpretar como bug — es feature inesperada, no defecto.
examples: Chain-of-thought reasoning is an emergent capability at ~62B parameters. → especifico
Some emergent behaviors surprise even the researchers who built the models. → observacion honesta

questions.statement: 'Multimodal' AI can process multiple types of input like text, images, and audio.
questions.explanation: VERDADERO. Multimodal = maneja multiples modalidades (text + image + audio + video) en input y/o output. GPT-4o (OpenAI), Gemini (Google), Claude Sonnet 4+ (Anthropic) son multimodal. Frontera actual de AI 2024-2026. Casos de uso: describir imagenes, analizar graficos, transcribir audio, generar imagenes desde texto. Registro: AI/tech universal. Error hispano: pronunciacion — 'multimodal' es /ˌmʌltiˈmoʊdəl/. Distincion tecnica: native multimodal (una arquitectura) vs pipeline multimodal (modelos separados encadenados) — native es superior.
examples: Multimodal models can describe images and analyze complex charts natively. → capacidad clave
GPT-4o is natively multimodal in text, audio, and vision. → arquitectura moderna

questions.prompt: Un colega junior no entiende por que el modelo funciona perfecto en test pero mal en produccion.
questions.question: 'Overfitting' in ML means:
options: The model is too complex to run efficiently.
Model memorizes training data but fails to generalize to new data.
Training takes too much time and compute.
The model is too small to learn.
questions.explanation: Overfitting = modelo memoriza patterns especificos del training data en vez de aprender la senal generalizable. Signal claro: high train accuracy, low test/validation accuracy. Problema CLASICO de ML, ensenado en cada curso 101. Soluciones: mas data, regularization (L1, L2, dropout), early stopping, cross-validation, data augmentation. Registro: ML fundamental. Error hispano: 'overfit' se pronuncia /ˌoʊvərˈfɪt/. Contraste: 'underfitting' es modelo demasiado simple que no captura patterns.
examples: Overfitting is why we always hold out a validation set — never train on it. → best practice
Regularization helps prevent overfitting by penalizing model complexity. → tecnica clasica

questions.text: The model performs well on the benchmark but struggles with out-of-distribution examples in production.
questions.explanation: Discurso ML realista y humilde. Fenomeno de connected speech: 'performs well' con enlazado /pərˈfɔːrmzwel/; 'out-of-distribution' se pronuncia como unidad conceptual /aʊt əv ˌdɪstrɪˈbjuːʃən/; 'benchmark' con /ntʃ/ cluster complejo. 'Performs on benchmark' (bien en tests estandar) vs 'struggles' (falla) + 'out-of-distribution' (OOD, datos diferentes del training). Trap comun de deployment ML. Registro: ML engineering, production ML. Insight de senior ML engineer que ha visto modelos fallar en produccion.
examples: Benchmark performance doesn't always translate to production reliability. → advertencia realista
Out-of-distribution data is where models really get tested — and often fail. → observacion practica

questions.prompt: Debate sobre timelines de inteligencia artificial general.
questions.question: 'AGI' stands for:
questions.explanation: AGI = Artificial General Intelligence — AI que iguala o excede inteligencia humana en diversidad de tareas cognitivas. Termino contested; algunos investigadores lo rechazan como marketing; timelines debatidos ferozmente (Ray Kurzweil predice 2029, otros nunca). Pronunciacion letra por letra /eɪdʒiˈaɪ/. Registro: AI research, tech policy, journalism. Familia: ASI (Artificial Superintelligence, mas alla de humano), Narrow AI (task-specific, actual). Error hispano: pluralizar como 'AGIs' — se acepta pero suena raro; mejor 'AGI systems'.
examples: AGI predictions range from 5 years (optimists) to never (skeptics). → rango debate
Some argue current LLMs are already approaching AGI in narrow senses. → argumento actual

questions.statement: 'Chain-of-thought' prompting asks the model to think step by step, often improving accuracy dramatically.
questions.explanation: VERDADERO. Chain-of-thought (CoT) = prompting technique donde pides al modelo 'let's think step by step' antes de dar respuesta final. Simple pero boostea reasoning accuracy dramaticamente en LLMs — hallazgo seminal (Wei et al 2022). Es emergent property de scale: modelos pequenos no benefician; grandes si. Registro: AI research, prompt engineering. Aplicacion practica: cualquier user puede usar CoT anadiendo 'think step by step' a su prompt. Error hispano: subestimar como truco simple — es tecnica seria basada en evidencia empirica solida.
examples: Chain-of-thought turned math accuracy from 20% to 60% in the original paper. → dato historico
Just adding 'think step by step' improves complex reasoning noticeably. → truco practico

questions.target: The challenge with LLMs isn't intelligence — it's calibration: knowing when to trust the output and when to verify.
questions.explanation: Discurso maduro sobre AI de nivel AI leader/thinker. 'Calibration' (concepto tecnico: confianza reportada vs accuracy real) + 'trust the output' (uso responsable) + 'when to verify' (workflow humano-AI). Insight sofisticado que distingue amateur ('AI is magic') de senior ('AI needs verification workflows'). Ritmo natural: pausa marcada tras 'intelligence —', tempo reflexivo, enfasis en 'calibration' y 'verify'. Contracciones: 'isn't', 'it's' obligatorias. Registro: AI thought leadership, tipico de keynote CTO o AI safety researcher.
examples: The hard part isn't building AI — it's evaluating it. → insight de senior
Reliability, not capability, is the current frontier of production AI. → observacion 2024+
